Triggered by CLI (`cli_graph.py`) in v0; a Postgres hook on new normalized session lands in
v1 (§10).

Operations:

```
create(session)          build + persist a new graph

destroy(session)         drop graph + store

Implement **Step 6 — CLI** of `docs/plan/2026-08-10-causal-graph-implementation.md` §Step 6, per `docs/design/causal-graph-design.md` §8.

**FIRST — self-check the worktree base.** Run `git log --oneline -8` and `git branch --show-current`. You MUST see `22c31ac causal_graph Step 5: Tier-1 API` and `f31272d ... export full public surface`. Confirm `analysis.causal_graph` exposes (import and check) `build_family, dump_graph, load_graph, run_plan, goods, subagents, tool_usage, failed_tools, turns, loops, budget`. If missing, STOP and report "WORKTREE BASE WRONG"; create nothing.

**Own only:** `src/analysis/causal_graph/cli_graph.py`, `utils/graph.sh`, `tests/analysis/causal_graph/test_cli.py`. Touch nothing else. (Do NOT edit `__init__.py`, api/budget/family/etc.)

**Implement `cli_graph.py`** (argparse; a `main(argv=None)` entry point so tests can call it directly). Subcommands:
- `build <normalized_envelope.json> -o <out_dir>` — read a normalizer envelope `{meta_info, sessions[]}`, `build_family`, and persist: write each graph in the family to `<out_dir>/<session_id>.json` via `dump_graph`. Print a one-line summary (master id, #children, #nodes).
- `load <out_dir>` — read every `*.json` in the dir via `load_graph`, reassemble a `Family` (master = the graph whose `parent_session_id` is null; the rest are children keyed by session_id), print a summary. Provide a small local helper `load_family(dir) -> Family` for this.
- `query <src> --fn <name> [--scope tree] [--arg k=v ...]` OR `query <src> --plan <plan.json> [--scope tree]` — `<src>` is either a persisted `<out_dir>` (load_family) or a raw normalizer envelope `.json` (build_family on the fly; detect by `{sessions:...}` vs a dir). `--fn` calls the named Tier-1 function (`goods|subagents|tool_usage|failed_tools|turns|loops|budget`); `--plan` runs a Tier-2 JSON plan via `run_plan`. Print the result as JSON (nodes rendered by id, so results are serializable — convert Node objects to their id or a small dict).

CLAUDE.md naming: the CLI file is `cli_graph.py` (module `analysis.causal_graph.cli_graph`); it manages graphs, which the name describes.

**`utils/graph.sh`** — a thin wrapper: `PYTHONPATH=src exec venv/bin/python -m analysis.causal_graph.cli_graph "$@"` (executable, `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `set -euo pipefail`). Match the style of other `utils/*.sh` wrappers if present.

**`test_cli.py`** — call `cli_graph.main([...])` directly (not subprocess) using pytest `tmp_path`. Author a tiny normalizer envelope (a master + one subagent, reuse shapes from `tests/fixtures/causal_graph/tiny_family.json` — read it, don't modify). Assert: `build` writes one file per session and they `load` back into a Family with the right master/children; `query --fn failed_tools` and `query --plan` return the expected results; result output is valid JSON. Capture stdout via `capsys`.

Do NOT read `/Users/sumandra/projects/talium/traces`. Run `venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/analysis/causal_graph -q` — all green. **Repo rules:** Python 3.11+, `venv/bin/python -m pytest`, no `git -C`, NEVER reference Claude/Claude Code in code/comments/output. Report git self-check, files changed, assertions + results, assumptions. Do NOT commit or merge.
